Name: Where the Spreading Weeds Are - More Farm Damage Info
Author: pneuma163
Description:
[size=3]"The spreading weeds have caused damage to your farm." You've seen the notification. Well, this mod does three main things:

[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Adds its own notification that lists what got damaged[/size]
[*][size=3]Renders an overlay of what got damaged at its former location to draw attention to it[/size]
[*][size=3]Renders an 'X' that points at damage - if the damage is off screen, an arrow points to it[/size]
[*][size=3]With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28256]World Navigator[/url]﻿: Adds damaged spots to World Navigator's Today's Points of Interest menu[/size]

[/list][size=3]

[size=5]How to install:[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list][size=3]If you need additional help installing the mod, the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Stardew Valley wiki[/url]﻿ has more detailed instructions.
To uninstall the mod, delete this mod's folder from your Mods folder.
[/size]

[/size][size=3][b][size=4]Features:[/size]
[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Recognizes destruction on the [b]main farm[/b], the [b]Ginger Island farm[/b], and [b]anywhere else[/b] the spreading of weeds destroys something[/size]
[*][size=3]A simple [b]heads up display (HUD) message[/b] at the start of the day describing the damage[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Animated images[/b] of what was destroyed at each tile[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Arrows on the edge of the screen[/b] point to any damage that is off screen[/size]
[*][size=3]If you place another object at a location of damage or till the soil, the overlay goes away (the overlay also goes away at the end of the day)[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28256]World Navigator[/url]﻿[/b] and damaged spots will be added to World Navigator's Today's Points of Interest menu (you can turn off many of Where the Spreading Weeds Are's visuals in its config if you prefer to rely only on World Navigator's notifications and pointers)[/size]
[*][size=3]A few useful [b]config options[/b] for both visuals and function with full [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ support[/size]
[*][size=3][b]i18n support[/b] for additional languages - you are welcome to upload your i18n file for your language as its own mod as long as you also set this mod as a dependency, but also feel free to send me translations and I can include them in the main file (please note: you may not use AI to create a translation)[/size]
[/list][size=3]
See the images above or watch this 30 second video for a glimpse of some of the mod at work:

[youtube]0siZ_m3gEFc[/youtube]

[/size][size=4][b]FAQ:[/b][/size][size=3]
Does this stop the damage?
- No.

Is this compatible with multiplayer?
- Yes it is based on my own testing. I have not tested it with split screen so you may run into issues in that case, though.

Is this compatible with Windows, Mac, Linux, or Android (or other) versions of Stardew Valley?
- This mod is compatible with Windows, Mac, and Linux versions of Stardew Valley 1.6. It may not be compatible with Android or other versions of Stardew Valley and I cannot provide that compatibility.

Is this compatible with other mods?
- Yes. I have tested it with modded machines, crops, paths, locations, and recolors and this mod works as expected. Please let me know if you have trouble with it.

The damage report went away too quickly for me to see it!
- If you want to see it again, you can restart the day. Alternatively you can type "wtswa report" (without the quotation marks) into the SMAPI console and hit enter and it will print today's report in the console as well as map coordinates for each location (the HUD message only displays at the start of a day).

[b]How to report a problem or a bug:[/b]
Type "wtswa data" (without the quotation marks) into your SMAPI console and hit enter (do this for every player, if multiplayer). Upload your log to [url=https://smapi.io/log/]https://smapi.io/log/[/url] using the instructions on that website and share the link that it provides along with any details that you think are relevant.
